in_marathi.name: Nadeshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Compassion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nadeshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nada: Sound or Vibration. Ishwari: Goddess. Nadeshwari is the goddess who embodies compassion, grace, and mercy. She is revered as the divine mother, who is always ready to listen and console.
